list.name: client_platform
list.label: 客户端平台
list.query: WebGL : webgl,Windows Player : windows,Unity Editor : editor,其他客户端 : other,未知/历史未上报 : unknown,无客户端归属 : unattributed

list.name: release_version
list.label: 发布版本
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version,''),'__empty__') AS __text,COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version,''),'__empty__') AS __value FROM analytics_sessions ORDER BY 1 DESC

list.name: test_data
list.label: 测试数据
list.query: 按平台自动 : auto,排除 : exclude,包含 : include,仅测试 : only

list.name: behavior_period
list.label: 行为范围
list.query: 历史累计 : all,所选时间 : range

list.name: sort_field
list.label: 排序字段
list.query: 游玩时长 : play_seconds,游戏日数 : play_days,岛屿等级 : island_level,首次登录 : first_login,最新登录 : latest_login,金币余额 : money

panels.title: 玩家基础数据
panels.description: 累计按玩家去重；当前状态取最新快照。缺失显示未采集，数值零保留。行为可切换期间，日期为北京时间。

targets.queryText:
SELECT * FROM (WITH e0 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM analytics_events WHERE ('__all__' IN (${client_platform:sqlstring}) OR client_platform IN (${client_platform:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version,''),'__empty__') IN (${release_version:sqlstring})) AND ('${test_data}'='include' OR ('${test_data}'='auto' AND (client_platform='editor' OR (is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0))) OR ('${test_data}'='exclude' AND is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0 AND client_platform!='editor') OR ('${test_data}'='only' AND (is_development_build=1 OR is_developer=1 OR client_platform='editor')))),
    s AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM analytics_sessions WHERE ('__all__' IN (${client_platform:sqlstring}) OR client_platform IN (${client_platform:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version,''),'__empty__') IN (${release_version:sqlstring})) AND ('${test_data}'='include' OR ('${test_data}'='auto' AND (client_platform='editor' OR (is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0))) OR ('${test_data}'='exclude' AND is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0 AND client_platform!='editor') OR ('${test_data}'='only' AND (is_development_build=1 OR is_developer=1 OR client_platform='editor')))),
    chat_source AS (SELECT c.*,COALESCE(u.is_developer,0) is_developer FROM conversations c LEFT JOIN user_sessions u ON c.user_id=u.user_id),
    chats AS (SELECT * FROM chat_source WHERE ('__all__' IN (${client_platform:sqlstring}) OR client_platform IN (${client_platform:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version,''),'__empty__') IN (${release_version:sqlstring})) AND ('${test_data}'='include' OR ('${test_data}'='auto' AND (client_platform='editor' OR (is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0))) OR ('${test_data}'='exclude' AND is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0 AND client_platform!='editor') OR ('${test_data}'='only' AND (is_development_build=1 OR is_developer=1 OR client_platform='editor')))),
    ids AS (SELECT user_id FROM s UNION SELECT user_id FROM e0),
    states AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY julianday(occurred_at) DESC,sequence DESC,event_id DESC) rn
        FROM e0 WHERE event_type='player_state_snapshot'),
    legacy AS (SELECT g.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY julianday(real_time_started_iso) DESC,imported_at DESC) rn
        FROM gameplay_sessions g WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM s WHERE s.user_id=g.user_id AND s.session_id=g.session_id)),
    days AS (SELECT user_id,COUNT(*) play_days FROM
        (SELECT DISTINCT user_id,archive_id,game_day FROM e0 WHERE NULLIF(archive_id,'') IS NOT NULL AND game_day IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY user_id),
    p AS (SELECT ids.user_id,COALESCE(NULLIF(json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.nickname'),''),NULLIF(u.nickname,''),NULLIF(u.player_name,''),ids.user_id) nickname,
        (SELECT SUM(duration_sec) FROM s WHERE s.user_id=ids.user_id) play_seconds,
        (SELECT first_entry_at FROM analytics_first_entry f WHERE f.user_id=ids.user_id AND f.cohort_scope=CASE WHEN '${test_data}' IN ('include','only') OR ('${test_data}'='auto' AND ('editor' IN (${client_platform:sqlstring}) OR '__all__' IN (${client_platform:sqlstring}))) THEN 'all' ELSE 'production' END) first_login,
        (SELECT MAX(started_at) FROM s WHERE s.user_id=ids.user_id) latest_login,
        d.play_days,COALESCE(json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.money'),l.money_end,l.money_start) money,
        COALESCE(json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.island_level'),l.island_level_max) island_level,
        json_array_length(json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.cats')) cat_count,
        st.payload_json state,st.occurred_at state_at,
        (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT client_version) FROM s WHERE s.user_id=ids.user_id) client_versions,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chats WHERE chats.user_id=ids.user_id AND COALESCE(NULLIF(message_type,''),'chat')='chat' AND COALESCE(user_query,'')<>'' AND COALESCE(is_preset,0)=0 AND ('${behavior_period}'='all' OR julianday(timestamp) >= julianday(${__from}/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(timestamp) < julianday(${__to}/1000,'unixepoch'))) active_chat_count,
        u.tasks_completed,u.tasks_total,u.current_task_title,u.current_task_status,
        (SELECT MIN(real_time_started_iso) FROM legacy WHERE legacy.user_id=ids.user_id) first_telemetry,
        l.real_time_started_iso latest_telemetry,
        COALESCE((SELECT MAX(timestamp) FROM chats WHERE chats.user_id=ids.user_id AND message_type='login'),(SELECT MAX(started_at) FROM s WHERE s.user_id=ids.user_id)) real_login,
        json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.cat_house_count') house_count,
        json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.cat_house_capacity') house_capacity,
        json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.cat_house_occupied') house_occupied
        FROM ids LEFT JOIN user_sessions u USING(user_id) LEFT JOIN states st ON st.user_id=ids.user_id AND st.rn=1
        LEFT JOIN legacy l ON l.user_id=ids.user_id AND l.rn=1 LEFT JOIN days d USING(user_id)),
    e AS (SELECT * FROM e0 WHERE ('${behavior_period}'='all' OR julianday(occurred_at) >= julianday(${__from}/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(occurred_at) < julianday(${__to}/1000,'unixepoch'))
        OR (occurred_at IS NULL AND '${behavior_period}'='all')),
    players AS (SELECT * FROM p WHERE (COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')<>'' AND (COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')='' OR user_id=COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')))),
    events AS (SELECT * FROM e WHERE (COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')<>'' AND (COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')='' OR user_id=COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')))) SELECT nickname 昵称,user_id,ROUND(play_seconds/60.0,2) 游玩分钟,play_days 游戏日数,island_level 岛屿等级,datetime(first_login,'+8 hours') 首次登录,datetime(latest_login,'+8 hours') 最新登录,money 金币余额,cat_count 猫数量,state_at 快照时间 FROM players) WHERE COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')<>''

    chat_source AS (SELECT c.*,COALESCE(u.is_developer,0) is_developer FROM conversations c LEFT JOIN user_sessions u ON c.user_id=u.user_id),
    chats AS (SELECT * FROM chat_source WHERE ('__all__' IN (${client_platform:sqlstring}) OR client_platform IN (${client_platform:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version,''),'__empty__') IN (${release_version:sqlstring})) AND ('${test_data}'='include' OR ('${test_data}'='auto' AND (client_platform='editor' OR (is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0))) OR ('${test_data}'='exclude' AND is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0 AND client_platform!='editor') OR ('${test_data}'='only' AND (is_development_build=1 OR is_developer=1 OR client_platform='editor')))),
    ids AS (SELECT user_id FROM s UNION SELECT user_id FROM e0),
    states AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY julianday(occurred_at) DESC,sequence DESC,event_id DESC) rn
        FROM e0 WHERE event_type='player_state_snapshot'),
    legacy AS (SELECT g.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY julianday(real_time_started_iso) DESC,imported_at DESC) rn

        (SELECT DISTINCT user_id,archive_id,game_day FROM e0 WHERE NULLIF(archive_id,'') IS NOT NULL AND game_day IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY user_id),
    p AS (SELECT ids.user_id,COALESCE(NULLIF(json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.nickname'),''),NULLIF(u.nickname,''),NULLIF(u.player_name,''),ids.user_id) nickname,

        (SELECT MAX(started_at) FROM s WHERE s.user_id=ids.user_id) latest_login,
        d.play_days,COALESCE(json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.money'),l.money_end,l.money_start) money,
        COALESCE(json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.island_level'),l.island_level_max) island_level,
        json_array_length(json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.cats')) cat_count,
        st.payload_json state,st.occurred_at state_at,
        (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT client_version) FROM s WHERE s.user_id=ids.user_id) client_versions,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chats WHERE chats.user_id=ids.user_id AND COALESCE(NULLIF(message_type,''),'chat')='chat' AND COALESCE(user_query,'')<>'' AND COALESCE(is_preset,0)=0 AND ('${behavior_period}'='all' OR julianday(timestamp) >= julianday(${__from}/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(timestamp) < julianday(${__to}/1000,'unixepoch'))) active_chat_count,
        u.tasks_completed,u.tasks_total,u.current_task_title,u.current_task_status,
        (SELECT MIN(real_time_started_iso) FROM legacy WHERE legacy.user_id=ids.user_id) first_telemetry,
        l.real_time_started_iso latest_telemetry,
        COALESCE((SELECT MAX(timestamp) FROM chats WHERE chats.user_id=ids.user_id AND message_type='login'),(SELECT MAX(started_at) FROM s WHERE s.user_id=ids.user_id)) real_login,
        json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.cat_house_count') house_count,
        json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.cat_house_capacity') house_capacity,
        json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.cat_house_occupied') house_occupied
        FROM ids LEFT JOIN user_sessions u USING(user_id) LEFT JOIN states st ON st.user_id=ids.user_id AND st.rn=1
        LEFT JOIN legacy l ON l.user_id=ids.user_id AND l.rn=1 LEFT JOIN days d USING(user_id)),
    e AS (SELECT * FROM e0 WHERE ('${behavior_period}'='all' OR julianday(occurred_at) >= julianday(${__from}/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(occurred_at) < julianday(${__to}/1000,'unixepoch'))
        OR (occurred_at IS NULL AND '${behavior_period}'='all')),
    players AS (SELECT * FROM p WHERE (COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')<>'' AND (COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')='' OR user_id=COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')))),
    events AS (SELECT * FROM e WHERE (COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')<>'' AND (COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')='' OR user_id=COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')))) SELECT json_extract(c.value,'$.slot') 部位,json_extract(c.value,'$.item_name') 服装 FROM players,json_each(state,'$.outfits') c) WHERE COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')<>''

    s AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM analytics_sessions WHERE ('__all__' IN (${client_platform:sqlstring}) OR client_platform IN (${client_platform:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version,''),'__empty__') IN (${release_version:sqlstring})) AND ('${test_data}'='include' OR ('${test_data}'='auto' AND (client_platform='editor' OR (is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0))) OR ('${test_data}'='exclude' AND is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0 AND client_platform!='editor') OR ('${test_data}'='only' AND (is_development_build=1 OR is_developer=1 OR client_platform='editor')))),
    chat_source AS (SELECT c.*,COALESCE(u.is_developer,0) is_developer FROM conversations c LEFT JOIN user_sessions u ON c.user_id=u.user_id),
    chats AS (SELECT * FROM chat_source WHERE ('__all__' IN (${client_platform:sqlstring}) OR client_platform IN (${client_platform:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version,''),'__empty__') IN (${release_version:sqlstring})) AND ('${test_data}'='include' OR ('${test_data}'='auto' AND (client_platform='editor' OR (is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0))) OR ('${test_data}'='exclude' AND is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0 AND client_platform!='editor') OR ('${test_data}'='only' AND (is_development_build=1 OR is_developer=1 OR client_platform='editor')))),
    ids AS (SELECT user_id FROM s UNION SELECT user_id FROM e0),
    states AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY julianday(occurred_at) DESC,sequence DESC,event_id DESC) rn
        FROM e0 WHERE event_type='player_state_snapshot'),
    legacy AS (SELECT g.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY julianday(real_time_started_iso) DESC,imported_at DESC) rn
        FROM gameplay_sessions g WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM s WHERE s.user_id=g.user_id AND s.session_id=g.session_id)),
    days AS (SELECT user_id,COUNT(*) play_days FROM
        (SELECT DISTINCT user_id,archive_id,game_day FROM e0 WHERE NULLIF(archive_id,'') IS NOT NULL AND game_day IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY user_id),
    p AS (SELECT ids.user_id,COALESCE(NULLIF(json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.nickname'),''),NULLIF(u.nickname,''),NULLIF(u.player_name,''),ids.user_id) nickname,
        (SELECT SUM(duration_sec) FROM s WHERE s.user_id=ids.user_id) play_seconds,
        (SELECT first_entry_at FROM analytics_first_entry f WHERE f.user_id=ids.user_id AND f.cohort_scope=CASE WHEN '${test_data}' IN ('include','only') OR ('${test_data}'='auto' AND ('editor' IN (${client_platform:sqlstring}) OR '__all__' IN (${client_platform:sqlstring}))) THEN 'all' ELSE 'production' END) first_login,
        (SELECT MAX(started_at) FROM s WHERE s.user_id=ids.user_id) latest_login,
        d.play_days,COALESCE(json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.money'),l.money_end,l.money_start) money,
        COALESCE(json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.island_level'),l.island_level_max) island_level,
        json_array_length(json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.cats')) cat_count,
        st.payload_json state,st.occurred_at state_at,
        (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT client_version) FROM s WHERE s.user_id=ids.user_id) client_versions,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chats WHERE chats.user_id=ids.user_id AND COALESCE(NULLIF(message_type,''),'chat')='chat' AND COALESCE(user_query,'')<>'' AND COALESCE(is_preset,0)=0 AND ('${behavior_period}'='all' OR julianday(timestamp) >= julianday(${__from}/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(timestamp) < julianday(${__to}/1000,'unixepoch'))) active_chat_count,
        u.tasks_completed,u.tasks_total,u.current_task_title,u.current_task_status,
        (SELECT MIN(real_time_started_iso) FROM legacy WHERE legacy.user_id=ids.user_id) first_telemetry,
        l.real_time_started_iso latest_telemetry,
        COALESCE((SELECT MAX(timestamp) FROM chats WHERE chats.user_id=ids.user_id AND message_type='login'),(SELECT MAX(started_at) FROM s WHERE s.user_id=ids.user_id)) real_login,
        json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.cat_house_count') house_count,
        json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.cat_house_capacity') house_capacity,
        json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.cat_house_occupied') house_occupied
        FROM ids LEFT JOIN user_sessions u USING(user_id) LEFT JOIN states st ON st.user_id=ids.user_id AND st.rn=1
        LEFT JOIN legacy l ON l.user_id=ids.user_id AND l.rn=1 LEFT JOIN days d USING(user_id)),
    e AS (SELECT * FROM e0 WHERE ('${behavior_period}'='all' OR julianday(occurred_at) >= julianday(${__from}/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(occurred_at) < julianday(${__to}/1000,'unixepoch'))
        OR (occurred_at IS NULL AND '${behavior_period}'='all')),
    players AS (SELECT * FROM p WHERE (COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')<>'' AND (COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')='' OR user_id=COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')))),
    events AS (SELECT * FROM e WHERE (COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')<>'' AND (COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')='' OR user_id=COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')))) SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(json_extract(payload_json,'$.building_name'),''),'未采集名称') 名称,COUNT(*) 次数,COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) 参与玩家数 FROM events WHERE event_type='building_placed' AND actor_is_player=1 AND 1 GROUP BY COALESCE(json_extract(payload_json,'$.building_id'),json_extract(payload_json,'$.building_name')) ORDER BY 次数 DESC,名称 LIMIT 5) WHERE COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')<>''

    s AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM analytics_sessions WHERE ('__all__' IN (${client_platform:sqlstring}) OR client_platform IN (${client_platform:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version,''),'__empty__') IN (${release_version:sqlstring})) AND ('${test_data}'='include' OR ('${test_data}'='auto' AND (client_platform='editor' OR (is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0))) OR ('${test_data}'='exclude' AND is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0 AND client_platform!='editor') OR ('${test_data}'='only' AND (is_development_build=1 OR is_developer=1 OR client_platform='editor')))),
    chat_source AS (SELECT c.*,COALESCE(u.is_developer,0) is_developer FROM conversations c LEFT JOIN user_sessions u ON c.user_id=u.user_id),
    chats AS (SELECT * FROM chat_source WHERE ('__all__' IN (${client_platform:sqlstring}) OR client_platform IN (${client_platform:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version,''),'__empty__') IN (${release_version:sqlstring})) AND ('${test_data}'='include' OR ('${test_data}'='auto' AND (client_platform='editor' OR (is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0))) OR ('${test_data}'='exclude' AND is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0 AND client_platform!='editor') OR ('${test_data}'='only' AND (is_development_build=1 OR is_developer=1 OR client_platform='editor')))),
    ids AS (SELECT user_id FROM s UNION SELECT user_id FROM e0),
    states AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY julianday(occurred_at) DESC,sequence DESC,event_id DESC) rn
        FROM e0 WHERE event_type='player_state_snapshot'),
    legacy AS (SELECT g.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY julianday(real_time_started_iso) DESC,imported_at DESC) rn
        FROM gameplay_sessions g WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM s WHERE s.user_id=g.user_id AND s.session_id=g.session_id)),
    days AS (SELECT user_id,COUNT(*) play_days FROM
        (SELECT DISTINCT user_id,archive_id,game_day FROM e0 WHERE NULLIF(archive_id,'') IS NOT NULL AND game_day IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY user_id),
    p AS (SELECT ids.user_id,COALESCE(NULLIF(json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.nickname'),''),NULLIF(u.nickname,''),NULLIF(u.player_name,''),ids.user_id) nickname,
        (SELECT SUM(duration_sec) FROM s WHERE s.user_id=ids.user_id) play_seconds,
        (SELECT first_entry_at FROM analytics_first_entry f WHERE f.user_id=ids.user_id AND f.cohort_scope=CASE WHEN '${test_data}' IN ('include','only') OR ('${test_data}'='auto' AND ('editor' IN (${client_platform:sqlstring}) OR '__all__' IN (${client_platform:sqlstring}))) THEN 'all' ELSE 'production' END) first_login,
        (SELECT MAX(started_at) FROM s WHERE s.user_id=ids.user_id) latest_login,
        d.play_days,COALESCE(json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.money'),l.money_end,l.money_start) money,
        COALESCE(json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.island_level'),l.island_level_max) island_level,
        json_array_length(json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.cats')) cat_count,
        st.payload_json state,st.occurred_at state_at,
        (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT client_version) FROM s WHERE s.user_id=ids.user_id) client_versions,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chats WHERE chats.user_id=ids.user_id AND COALESCE(NULLIF(message_type,''),'chat')='chat' AND COALESCE(user_query,'')<>'' AND COALESCE(is_preset,0)=0 AND ('${behavior_period}'='all' OR julianday(timestamp) >= julianday(${__from}/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(timestamp) < julianday(${__to}/1000,'unixepoch'))) active_chat_count,
        u.tasks_completed,u.tasks_total,u.current_task_title,u.current_task_status,
        (SELECT MIN(real_time_started_iso) FROM legacy WHERE legacy.user_id=ids.user_id) first_telemetry,
        l.real_time_started_iso latest_telemetry,
        COALESCE((SELECT MAX(timestamp) FROM chats WHERE chats.user_id=ids.user_id AND message_type='login'),(SELECT MAX(started_at) FROM s WHERE s.user_id=ids.user_id)) real_login,
        json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.cat_house_count') house_count,
        json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.cat_house_capacity') house_capacity,
        json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.cat_house_occupied') house_occupied
        FROM ids LEFT JOIN user_sessions u USING(user_id) LEFT JOIN states st ON st.user_id=ids.user_id AND st.rn=1
        LEFT JOIN legacy l ON l.user_id=ids.user_id AND l.rn=1 LEFT JOIN days d USING(user_id)),
    e AS (SELECT * FROM e0 WHERE ('${behavior_period}'='all' OR julianday(occurred_at) >= julianday(${__from}/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(occurred_at) < julianday(${__to}/1000,'unixepoch'))
        OR (occurred_at IS NULL AND '${behavior_period}'='all')),
    players AS (SELECT * FROM p WHERE (COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')<>'' AND (COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')='' OR user_id=COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')))),
    events AS (SELECT * FROM e WHERE (COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')<>'' AND (COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')='' OR user_id=COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')))) SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(json_extract(payload_json,'$.item_name'),''),'未采集名称') 名称,COUNT(*) 次数,COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) 参与玩家数,SUM(COALESCE(json_extract(payload_json,'$.quantity'),1)) 件数 FROM events WHERE event_type='shop_purchase' AND actor_is_player=1 AND json_extract(payload_json,'$.shop_type')='variety' GROUP BY COALESCE(json_extract(payload_json,'$.item_id'),json_extract(payload_json,'$.item_name')) ORDER BY 次数 DESC,名称 LIMIT 5) WHERE COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')<>''

 FROM invitations i LEFT JOIN choices c ON c.user_id=i.user_id AND c.session_id=i.session_id

panels.description: 累计按玩家去重；当前状态取最新快照。缺失显示未采集，数值零保留。行为可切换期间，日期为北京时间。

targets.queryText:
SELECT * FROM (WITH e0 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM analytics_events WHERE ('__all__' IN (${client_platform:sqlstring}) OR client_platform IN (${client_platform:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version,''),'__empty__') IN (${release_version:sqlstring})) AND ('${test_data}'='include' OR ('${test_data}'='auto' AND (client_platform='editor' OR (is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0))) OR ('${test_data}'='exclude' AND is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0 AND client_platform!='editor') OR ('${test_data}'='only' AND (is_development_build=1 OR is_developer=1 OR client_platform='editor')))),
    s AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM analytics_sessions WHERE ('__all__' IN (${client_platform:sqlstring}) OR client_platform IN (${client_platform:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version,''),'__empty__') IN (${release_version:sqlstring})) AND ('${test_data}'='include' OR ('${test_data}'='auto' AND (client_platform='editor' OR (is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0))) OR ('${test_data}'='exclude' AND is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0 AND client_platform!='editor') OR ('${test_data}'='only' AND (is_development_build=1 OR is_developer=1 OR client_platform='editor')))),
    chat_source AS (SELECT c.*,COALESCE(u.is_developer,0) is_developer FROM conversations c LEFT JOIN user_sessions u ON c.user_id=u.user_id),
    chats AS (SELECT * FROM chat_source WHERE ('__all__' IN (${client_platform:sqlstring}) OR client_platform IN (${client_platform:sqlstring})) AND ('__all__' IN (${release_version:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(NULLIF(release_version,''),'__empty__') IN (${release_version:sqlstring})) AND ('${test_data}'='include' OR ('${test_data}'='auto' AND (client_platform='editor' OR (is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0))) OR ('${test_data}'='exclude' AND is_development_build=0 AND is_developer=0 AND client_platform!='editor') OR ('${test_data}'='only' AND (is_development_build=1 OR is_developer=1 OR client_platform='editor')))),
    ids AS (SELECT user_id FROM s UNION SELECT user_id FROM e0),
    states AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY julianday(occurred_at) DESC,sequence DESC,event_id DESC) rn
        FROM e0 WHERE event_type='player_state_snapshot'),
    legacy AS (SELECT g.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY julianday(real_time_started_iso) DESC,imported_at DESC) rn
        FROM gameplay_sessions g WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM s WHERE s.user_id=g.user_id AND s.session_id=g.session_id)),
    days AS (SELECT user_id,COUNT(*) play_days FROM
        (SELECT DISTINCT user_id,archive_id,game_day FROM e0 WHERE NULLIF(archive_id,'') IS NOT NULL AND game_day IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY user_id),
    p AS (SELECT ids.user_id,COALESCE(NULLIF(json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.nickname'),''),NULLIF(u.nickname,''),NULLIF(u.player_name,''),ids.user_id) nickname,
        (SELECT SUM(duration_sec) FROM s WHERE s.user_id=ids.user_id) play_seconds,
        (SELECT first_entry_at FROM analytics_first_entry f WHERE f.user_id=ids.user_id AND f.cohort_scope=CASE WHEN '${test_data}' IN ('include','only') OR ('${test_data}'='auto' AND ('editor' IN (${client_platform:sqlstring}) OR '__all__' IN (${client_platform:sqlstring}))) THEN 'all' ELSE 'production' END) first_login,
        (SELECT MAX(started_at) FROM s WHERE s.user_id=ids.user_id) latest_login,
        d.play_days,COALESCE(json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.money'),l.money_end,l.money_start) money,
        COALESCE(json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.island_level'),l.island_level_max) island_level,
        json_array_length(json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.cats')) cat_count,
        st.payload_json state,st.occurred_at state_at,
        (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT client_version) FROM s WHERE s.user_id=ids.user_id) client_versions,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chats WHERE chats.user_id=ids.user_id AND COALESCE(NULLIF(message_type,''),'chat')='chat' AND COALESCE(user_query,'')<>'' AND COALESCE(is_preset,0)=0 AND ('${behavior_period}'='all' OR julianday(timestamp) >= julianday(${__from}/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(timestamp) < julianday(${__to}/1000,'unixepoch'))) active_chat_count,
        u.tasks_completed,u.tasks_total,u.current_task_title,u.current_task_status,
        (SELECT MIN(real_time_started_iso) FROM legacy WHERE legacy.user_id=ids.user_id) first_telemetry,
        l.real_time_started_iso latest_telemetry,
        COALESCE((SELECT MAX(timestamp) FROM chats WHERE chats.user_id=ids.user_id AND message_type='login'),(SELECT MAX(started_at) FROM s WHERE s.user_id=ids.user_id)) real_login,
        json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.cat_house_count') house_count,
        json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.cat_house_capacity') house_capacity,
        json_extract(st.payload_json,'$.cat_house_occupied') house_occupied
        FROM ids LEFT JOIN user_sessions u USING(user_id) LEFT JOIN states st ON st.user_id=ids.user_id AND st.rn=1
        LEFT JOIN legacy l ON l.user_id=ids.user_id AND l.rn=1 LEFT JOIN days d USING(user_id)),
    e AS (SELECT * FROM e0 WHERE ('${behavior_period}'='all' OR julianday(occurred_at) >= julianday(${__from}/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(occurred_at) < julianday(${__to}/1000,'unixepoch'))
        OR (occurred_at IS NULL AND '${behavior_period}'='all')),
    players AS (SELECT * FROM p WHERE (COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')<>'' AND (COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')='' OR user_id=COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')))),
    events AS (SELECT * FROM e WHERE (COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')<>'' AND (COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')='' OR user_id=COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')))) SELECT occurred_at 时间,event_type 类型,metadata_json metadata,payload_json payload FROM events WHERE event_type IN ('cat_skill_allocated','cat_level_up','fishing_started','fishing_finished','cat_adopted','shop_purchase','shop_freeze_changed','cat_housing_changed','player_typing_started','player_typing_finished','theater_view','theater_choice','theater_exit','theater_line') ORDER BY julianday(occurred_at) DESC,sequence DESC,event_id DESC LIMIT 200 OFFSET (CAST(COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${page:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'0') AS INTEGER)*200)) WHERE COALESCE(json_extract(json_array(${user_id:sqlstring}),'$[0]'),'')<>''

options.content: **累计指标按玩家去重；当前状态按最新快照，空值=未采集。** 游戏日按玩家+存档+游戏日去重，旧数据缺存档标识不猜测。金币为当前余额。行为默认历史累计，可切换期间；未知平台保留。新指标需新版客户端/服务器。体力使用实际扣除事件；旧版失败钓鱼无法补采。
